title: Human rights in the age of technofeudalism
description: Practical examples of surveillance and guidance for resistance as an individual/community. Overview of governments and companies invading our rights, how society silently gave up on right to privacy and how to gain it back. Goal is to inspire people not to accept compromises, actually commit to tools that are free and enable coordination
abstract: The freedom we can leverage by digital technologies is slowly being chipped away as the world turns more autocratic. But no reason to give up on cryptoanarchy just yet! Our mission and tools are evolving, come to learn how to survive in modern techno-autocratic society
